jobs.title: IT Operations Internship
jobs.description: About the role Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. At SkyNRG, IT plays an important role in enabling a fast-growing organization to scale efficiently and securely. As an IT Operations Intern, you will support the daily running of our IT environment while contributing to projects that improve how the business operates. During this internship, you will gain hands-on experience with user lifecycle management, first-line support, and modern cloud-based IT environments. In addition to operations, you will contribute to automation and cybersecurity initiatives that help shape the future of IT at SkyNRG. This role offers a the opportunity to combine operational IT work with project-based learning in a purpose driven organisation. Your Responsibilities: IT operations support: Support day-to-day IT operations, including user onboarding and offboarding, account setup, and maintaining access across systems. First-line support: Provide first-line technical support for hardware, software, and connectivity issues. Ticketing & maintenance: Assist with ticket triage in Jira Service Management, perform device checks, and support routine system maintenance. Automation projects: Contribute to automation initiatives using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio), helping streamline internal workflows such as user lifecycle processes. Cybersecurity support: Assist in cybersecurity initiatives, including improving incident reporting workflows and strengthening overall IT security practices. jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Investing. This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. What You'll Own Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services. Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans. Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions. Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations. Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity. What We're Looking For Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator

jobs.description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. The Role The Business Operations Manager works directly with the VP of Seller Operations to define, prioritise, and deliver strategic initiatives that improve how Motorway operates, grows, and delivers value to our sellers. This is a high-impact, dynamic leadership role focused on solving critical operational and commercial problems across the entire seller journey. You will be responsible for defining and managing the implementation of initiatives that improve the end-to-end seller experience, launching new solutions, and optimising existing processes. You will combine deep analytical thinking with robust program management to drive conversion, improve customer experience, reduce operational costs, and increase automation across the business. The scope of this role is intentionally broad and highly cross-functional. You will partner closely with senior stakeholders across operations, product, engineering, finance, marketing, and commercial teams to develop joint plans, align priorities, and execute complex solutions. Motorway moves quickly and operates in a constantly evolving environment. This role suits a strategic operator who thrives in ambiguity, possesses natural commercial curiosity, and excels at taking ownership of messy, complex problems and turning them into structured, scalable solutions. jobs.description: Über Navigator Group Navigator Group ist eine deutsche Industrieholding, die Unternehmensbereiche von größeren Gesellschaften sowie private Industriebetriebe übernimmt. Das Team aus Spezialisten für M&A, Finanzierung und Geschäftsentwicklung konzipiert maßgeschneiderte Transaktionsstrukturen und treibt die operative Weiterentwicklung der Portfoliounternehmen voran. Regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern stärken die Zusammenarbeit im Team. Ein Firmenlaptop stehen Ihnen für die Arbeit zur Verfügung. jobs.description: Radar Reinvented. Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities.
